label: Lumped vibration models
text: EN.O.A1.1.3 Lumped vibration models: single- and multi-degree-of-freedom systems with linear springs and viscous damping. Natural frequency ωn = √(k/m) for an undamped linear oscillator.

warrant.standard: Prediction matches test within stated uncertainty; code calibration meets the target reliability index
